title: Add stable permute and view_dtype (2.14+)
body:
## Summary
- Add `torch::stable::{permute,view_dtype}` wrappers (gated at 2.14) via `torch_call_dispatcher`
- Document the new APIs in the stable operators docs
- Cover them in the 2.14 libtorch-agnostic extension tests

~~Stacked on #191973. (testing new gh stack)~~
stack seemed to be disabled. Will rebase this when #191973 lands

see commits https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/192083/changes/94c2acfa4ec43ce046de24370be9ff1fa86a7c7d..c4e0c5c1ef85bb93cd0d6e3cc46cff6446222db7 for edits that are new to this PR.

## Test plan
- [x] `python -m pytest test/cpp_extensions/test_libtorch_agnostic.py -k 'test_my_permute or test_my_view_dtype'`

cc @janeyx99
